<section class="section section--intro">
  <div class="container two-column">
    <div>
      <p class="section-kicker">The group</p>
      <h2>Purpose</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="copy-block">
      <p>
        The stated aim of the group is to promote research in Bayesian inference and to disseminate its results among SEIO members, in the scientific community and in society at large.
      </p>
      <p>
        Its activity consists mainly of scientific sessions at the SEIO national congresses and of the International Workshop on Bayesian Statistics, held for the first time in 2024 and for the second in 2026. Sessions reserved for early-career researchers are a regular part of both.
      </p>
      <p class="section-more"><a class="inline-link" href="people.html">Coordinators and board</a></p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
